interpretation: PLAUR/uPAR is constitutively and highly expressed on NORMAL myeloid cells (neutrophils >> monocytes > conventional dendritic cells > macrophages) and is 'Detected in all' tissues. HPA classifies it as 'Cell type enhanced' / 'Immune cell enhanced', NOT senescence- or cell-type-specific. This quantitatively supports the seed hypothesis's open question: uPAR is senescence-ENRICHED, not senescence-SPECIFIC, and substantial baseline expression on healthy myeloid and epithelial lineages bounds its usefulness as a senolytic antigen (on-target/off-tumor risk).
